title: Predicted extraction shaft beneath the Red Pyramid

tellings.quote: there should be an extraction shaft coming from below the final synthesis chamber of the red pyramid.

plain: There should be a hidden shaft running down from beneath the last chamber of the Red Pyramid, an ancient pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, according to a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm. Drumm calls that room the "final synthesis chamber," meaning the place where, in his view, the pyramid finished producing something. He tells Michels the shaft is a prediction that follows from his own theory, not something anyone has found. If such a shaft turned up, it would suggest the pyramid was built to make a product and draw it out.
